body:
Maya: Hey triage folks — quick proposal: add a 10m async-only slot on Fridays for backlog grooming + RFC quick checks. Who can cover next Friday?

Julian: +1 for async slot, 10m sounds good. Can we make it at 11:00 PT?

Sam: I'm out Fri mornings but can cover afternoons. Can we poll 11:00 vs 2:00?

Li: prefer 2pm. Also suggest adding 'RFC quick reads' to agenda (2 min per item).

Maya: Cool — new agenda suggestion: 1) quick bug triage (5m) 2) RFC quick reads (up to 10m) 3) owner swap (5m). Keep overall <=30m but async-first.

Julian: +1. Also propose a two-owner handoff rule for high-sev bugs: primary + backup listed in the sheet. Low overhead, faster coverage.

OpsBot: Reminder: calendar event for #triage-auto has been created for next Friday 14:00 PT. RSVP to confirm. :calendar:

Sam: Can we add a short 'code-review pings' lane to the notes? Sometimes blockers are just reviews that need nudging.

Maya: Good call — we'll add CR pings as a 'parking lot' item (only called if blocking a release).

Li: I'll prepare a 3-item pre-read list of RFCs by Thu EOD and drop it in the thread. @Maya @Julian

Maya: Thanks. Also owners: please mark assigned bugs in the triage sheet before the async slot: https://bit.ly/rw-triage-sheet

Julian: Noted. Quick Q: do we rotate owners weekly or keep assignments for 2 weeks?

Maya: Let's trial weekly rotation for 3 cycles and revisit metrics (coverage, reopen rate).

Sam: 👍

Li: 👍 I'll be backup next week.

Maya: Great. If you can't make the async slot, please ping here and assign your backup. I'll update the calendar and agenda tonight.

OpsBot: Event updated: "Eng Triage — Async Friday" 14:00-14:30 PT. Attendees: Maya, Julian, Sam, Li (pending RSVP).
